blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Adamson posted back-to-back wins after trouncing University of the East, 67-50, in the UAAP Season 89 women’s basketball tournament on Sunday at Mall of Asia Arena. Fresh off a victory over University of the Philippines, the Lady Falcons leveled their record after starting the season at 0-2. “We’re finally getting the flow of our offense and we are seeing glimpses of how we want to play, especially in our previous game,” coach Jed Colonia said. “We just wanted to play with our identity, which is the running game and not too much of a half-court game.
